title: 1625 Prairie's south wall gets its low windows
items: In 1904, the south wall of 1625 Prairie now has the three low windows the 1890 photograph shows: a small round-topped one near the ground, a tall narrow round-topped one under the oriel, and a narrow slit just before the rear wing.
Its ground-floor window and its stair window lose the fan of brick over their tops. The photograph shows plain heads there.
All five are measured from the photograph through its matched camera. The wall is seen at a steep angle, so their widths are estimates, good to about half a foot.
